title: A hidden signal
base_prompt:
Fully animated cinematic stylized-realistic 3D CGI feature-film shot, continuous motion, expressive character animation and acting, believable fur and cloth simulation, detailed wet stone and metal, dynamic ocean, rain, spray, steam and sparks, cinematic lighting, anamorphic 16:9 widescreen, 24 fps.
Setting: the narrow curved iron-and-stone catwalk with a rusted iron railing circling the brass lantern room at the top of a weathered cliffside stone lighthouse, high above a rocky ocean and sea spray. Time and weather: stormy overcast day returning, cold slate-blue and grey palette, gusting wind and rain, an eerie emerald glow from the sea.
Characters (keep exactly on-model): Penny, a fourteen-year-old girl with windblown auburn curls under a patterned headscarf, freckles, a heavy canvas mechanic's apron full of wrenches, pliers and gears, and a grease-stained linen rag; clever, practical, young-looking; Tomkin, a compact, stout ginger-and-white tabby cat walking upright, wearing a thick ribbed grey wool sock folded over his ears like a baker's toque, a lavender silk boxer-shorts cape fastened at the neck with a brass safety pin, wielding a bent stainless-steel soup ladle like a rapier and carrying a yellow plastic butter tub; expressive, brave and comically self-important.
Camera: close two-shot pushing in on the butter tub; one continuous shot, no cuts.
Action: Penny kneels and lifts the butter tub off the captured drone core; it blinks a faint crimson light in a regular repeating rhythm. She holds a small brass listening device to it while Tomkin leans in, whiskers twitching.
No dialogue.
Sound: rhythmic electronic beeping, wind, rain.
Audio: realistic sound effects and ambience only; spoken dialogue only as written above; no background music; no narrator.
